description: Continued candidate extension of the Erdős #287 good-prime chain certificate.
notes: Each extension has p_next = 2q + 1 with q prime and p_next <= 2p_current - 3.
Therefore each new p_next is a good prime because (p_next-1)/2 is prime.
The verifier certifies primality using recursive Pocklington/Pratt-style certificates, not floating-point tests.
The e^2 and e-1 floor checks are verified using rational interval bounds for e from the exponential series.
status: candidate: verifies the chain, primality certificates, and exact arithmetic; depends on upstream forum chain theorem/lemma for #287 interpretation.
